notes: shenei ha-anashim writes one *the*, which the present article on the rectum takes even though English fronts it before the numeral (rule 29) — the same shape as JOS.2.4, and distinct from JOS.2.10's articleless malkhei, where the determiner is supplied on the counted noun.
The article on ha-motseot is rendered by the relative *that* (rule 41), and the dative le of *told him* is unrepresented (rule 40).
